name: Non-syndromic urogenital tract malformation of female

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and imaging criteria for non-syndromic female urogenital malformations

criteria.description: Presence of congenital structural anomalies of the female urogenital tract confirmed by imaging or surgical exploration
No associated systemic or syndromic abnormalities on clinical and genetic evaluation
Clinical signs such as primary amenorrhea, urinary incontinence, or recurrent urinary tract infections consistent with urogenital malformation

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of congenital urogenital tract structural anomaly without systemic or syndromic features confirmed by imaging or surgery
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of syndromic causes and genetic syndromes associated with urogenital malformations.

rare.symptomName: Chronic kidney disease due to obstructive uropathy
searchTerms: chronic kidney disease from urinary obstruction
kidney failure due to blocked urine flow

laboratory: Normal hormonal profile excluding endocrine syndromes
imaging: Pelvic ultrasound demonstrating absent or malformed uterus/vagina
MRI pelvis confirming Müllerian duct anomalies
Voiding cystourethrogram to assess urinary tract anomalies
genetic: No pathogenic variants in known syndromic urogenital malformation genes
other: Surgical exploration findings confirming isolated urogenital malformation

distinguishingFeatures: Syndromic presentation with uterine and vaginal agenesis
Presence of testes and androgen receptor mutations

redFlags: Absence of menstruation by age 16 with normal secondary sexual characteristics
Recurrent urinary tract infections resistant to standard treatment
Severe urinary retention or obstructive uropathy symptoms
